'''Jike''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] rock [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that occupied the closest [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position to the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Asar/Legends|Asar]]. It was located within the [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of the [[7G sector/Legends|7G sector]]<ref name="sector" /> that was situated within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jike was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Jike, in grid square G-7.<ref name="TEA" />
